steps.note: Open the Single Stage event creation screen.
Ensure vendors can be added during event creation as required by the case configuration.
Set the event type to RFQ.
Provide the required event title before configuring the sheet.
Apply the RFQ template so the pricing sheet and Quantity Requested column are available.
Add the CYLINDER product to create the first pricing-sheet row.
Enter the invalid alphabetic quantity and leave the cell to trigger inline validation.
Assert that the Quantity Requested cell did not keep the non-numeric value.
